newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil starts refinancing states' debt.
newsitem.headline: Brazil starts refinancing states' debt.

text.p: The Brazilian government was due to sign a deal with Rio Grande do Sul Friday to refinance the southern state's 7.5 billion real debt, a Finance Ministry spokesman said.
The deal was expected to be the first of several designed to reduce high debt-servicing costs that are undermining the states' fiscal accounts.
O Globo newspaper reported Thursday that the National Treasury planned to borrow up to $1.0 billion in global debt markets to raise money for the refinancing programme.
